verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator documents a Cloud Backup toggle that saves all accounts to a Microsoft personal account (iCloud on iOS). When you get a new device, you sign in to restore the saved accounts, which covers the core of the new-phone portability story. Missing for 10: evidence that the restore is a single guided step rather than a backup-then-sign-in process, confirmation that every token type (e.g., work/school accounts) restores without re-verification, cross-platform (iOS↔Android) transfer details, and independent hands-on corroboration of migration success.
